items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: I believe I was the only Louisiana-born fellow in the band in Cottrell and Arthur Durden.

ctx.x: No, but I mean the guys who were there at the time, mainly, huh? Right. You just only picked up a couple out there in the West.
I believe, Louis Cotter. Yes, we picked up Haram Harding in Dallas.
Well, I believe I was the only Louisiana-born fellow in the band in Cottrell and Arthur Durden. Arthur was born in New Orleans. You mean New Orleans? New Orleans.
